forwardingWizard.title: Set up forwarding step by step
forwardingWizard.intro: A few steps so the job alerts in your mailbox reach Jobbbox. Nothing is done in your mailbox for you: you stay in control.

provider.legend: Which mailbox gets your job alerts?

switchOn.read: What is read: only the text of the emails that reach your forwarding address from recognised alert senders or from your own addresses. Never their attachments or images.
switchOn.kept: What is kept: the offers found. An email's text is not kept once read (72 hours at most, encrypted, should it need reading again).

address.explanation: Copy this address: your mailbox will forward your alerts to it. It is yours alone.

hint.settings: A mailbox's settings are usually behind the gear icon, top right. Do these steps on a computer.

gmailAddress.title: Add your forwarding address in Gmail

steps.1: Open Gmail on a computer, then the settings (the gear icon) and "See all settings".
steps.2: Open the forwarding tab ("Forwarding and POP/IMAP").
steps.3: Choose "Add a forwarding address" and paste your forwarding address.
steps.4: Confirm: Gmail sends a confirmation code to that address. Jobbbox receives it and shows it to you in the next step.
steps.5: Do not choose to forward all your mail: only your alerts will be forwarded, by a filter, right after.

gmailFilter.title: Forward your alerts with a Gmail filter

steps.1: Leave automatic forwarding off in the forwarding tab: the filter does the forwarding.
steps.2: In Gmail's search bar, open the search options.
steps.3: In "From", type your alerts' senders separated by OR, for example: linkedin.com OR indeed.com OR cadremploi.fr.
steps.5: Tick "Forward it to" and choose your forwarding address.

outlook.title: Forward your alerts with an Outlook.com rule
outlook.notice: Outlook.com may ask you to turn on two-step verification, or to confirm your identity, before it allows forwarding. Labels may differ from those quoted here.

steps.1: Open Outlook.com on a computer, then the settings (the gear icon).
steps.2: Open the Mail part, then the rules.
steps.3: Add a rule whose condition is the sender: type your alerts' senders (linkedin.com, indeed.com, cadremploi.fr…).
steps.4: As the action, choose to forward the message, to your forwarding address.
steps.6: If Outlook.com asks you to verify your identity, follow its instructions: that is its usual protection of forwarding.

icloud.title: Forward your alerts with an iCloud Mail rule
icloud.notice: An iCloud rule forwards to one address only. Labels may differ from those quoted here.

steps.1: Open icloud.com/mail on a computer, then the settings.
steps.2: Open the rules and add one.
steps.3: As the condition, choose the sender, and type one of your alerts' senders (one rule per sender if needed).
steps.4: As the action, choose to forward, to your forwarding address.

manual.otherNotice: Yahoo and AOL offer automatic forwarding only with Mail Plus. For Free, SFR and other mailboxes, forward your alerts by hand until their automatic forwarding is tested.
